Lost in the Woods (Upper) Uphill Route

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Sunday, January 4, 2026 10:25 AM – Mountain crews have successfully opened key lower-mountain lifts across all three lodges. Heavy snowfall and winds persist, so please be mindful that operations may still be impacted by changing weather conditions. Deep snow means added risk out there. Please ski and ride with others, keep your group in sight, and avoid tree wells.

The following lifts are NOW OPEN: Broadway Express (1), Stump Alley Express (2), Roller Coaster Express (4), Unbound Express (6), Chair 7, Chair 8, Gold Rush Express (10), Discovery Express (11), Eagle Express (15), Schoolyard Express (17), Chair 20, Chair 21, the Lower Panorama Gondola, and Village Gondola.

Canyon Express (16) and Chair 22 will not operate today.

The following lifts are Closed and not expected to spin until the storm cycle clears: Face Lift Express (3), High 5 Express (5), Cloud Nine Express (9), Chair 12, Chair 13, Chair 14, Chair 23, and the Upper Panorama Gondola.

Conditions: Heavy snowfall and strong winds throughout the day. We've received over a foot of snow in the last 24 hours and it's still coming down; expect storm day conditions.  
Visibility: It's another low-vis day! Reach for the clear or low light lenses again today.  
Lift status:  14/25 lifts are open. High winds and storm conditions will affect operations throughout the day.  
Safety: Please avoid tree wells and try to land feet first when falling. Always ski and ride in a group and keep them in sight. Learn more about tree wells and Snow Immersion Suffocation. Please give heavy machinery space. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is: 760.934.0611
Road Conditions: Chains or snow tires are currently required. Check our Road Conditions page for more information.
